title: Philippines vs Thailand: Which Should You Visit?

faqs.answer: The Philippines wins for beaches — full stop. El Nido's limestone karst lagoons, Boracay's powdery White Beach, and Siargao's surf breaks are consistently ranked among the best in Asia. faqs.answer: Thailand is significantly easier to travel. Thailand has Bangkok's BTS/MRT metro, cheap domestic flights, overnight trains, and reliable ferries between islands. faqs.answer: The Philippines is generally safe in tourist areas. Manila gets mixed reviews for safety, but El Nido, Boracay, Cebu City, and Siargao are considered safe for most travelers. faqs.answer: Philippines: Best November–May (dry season). June–October is typhoon season — El Nido and Siargao can be hit hard. Palawan (El Nido/Coron) is best November–April. faqs.answer: Yes, but keep it focused. A 2-week Philippines trip should pick 2–3 island groups, not try to cover everything.
